title: 1RB0LB_1RC0LA_1LB0RD_1RE1RD_1RB1RF_1LA---: through its second-segment collapse, no halt to 3.07×10<sup>228</sup>
text: The lean accelerator ran on from 6.5×10<sup>197</sup>. The second segment of the counter ran out near 1.85×10<sup>228</sup>, as forecast; the empty digit passed under the top digits and was absorbed at 3.07×10<sup>228</sup>, without a halt. The twin 1RB0LC_1LA0RD_1RA0LA_1RE1RD_1RA1RF_1LC--- runs on in its usual cycle to 2.0×10<sup>229</sup>.
